name: Smart ray
summary: Raycasting that accumulates a score for every object the ray passes through over time, resolving targets from multiple pointing directions.
howItWorks: Objects intersected by the ray gain weight over time, so pointing at the target from slightly different directions disambiguates it from neighbours.

review.notes: Checked against Grossman & Balakrishnan (UIST 2006) in Oct 2026: evaluated on a volumetric display with targets within arm's reach, using a tracked one-button handheld device.
